build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with transition and potential graphs for sequence labeling
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph with nodes and arcs for a given number of classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph with arcs for each feature and class combination
sample_crf_sequences: sample random input-output sequence pairs from a trained linear-chain CRF model
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log-likelihood loss for a CRF given input and target sequences
